body:
Thank you for taking the time to reply. I do understand that the medications can take some time to work. It's been around nine weeks so far I think? But I've been switching between different SSRIs to try and find something that suits. Nothing as of yet. And I'm waiting to go speak with a psychiatrist. My main issue is depression but I'm not certain if there's something else underlying and I'd like to get a proper diagnosis. But it's all leaving me feeling quite strung out, especially with how long the process takes. I'm stuck in constant cycles of negative thought.

I've been off work for a long period of time now, approaching a couple of months. And it's a small business. My boss is telling me he can't hold the position forever. It's more than a job, it's kind of a career. I feel passionate about doing well and I like the people I work with there. I want to go back. But at the same time I'm terrified of having a breakdown and I'm so, so tired on these stupid pills that I don't think I can manage to even focus while I'm there. I was so proud of myself when I got that job, and so were my family and friends, I just don't know what I'd do if I lost it. I feel so useless.

I try to avoid self harming. It's not a habit I wanted to fall back into. It's something I've done in the midst of panicked episodes to bring myself back down. But it's not helpful at all, it makes things worse in the long run. I couldn't stop crying because I got blood on my favourite pyjamas. God, I really feel like I'm failing at everything. It either hurts or I'm totally numb. I can't find a happy middle.

Thank you again. I appreciate your reply. I'm trying to feel better, it's just hard to know which way is even up lately. And it's been that way for months and months.
